name: context-harness
description: Experimental: budgeted test runs with a stop-after-green rule, a guard for pre-existing tests, shaped test output and project memory for coding agents (skill, MCP server, hooks).

interface.shortDescription: Budgeted test runs, frozen pre-existing tests, project memory
interface.longDescription: Experimental harness for coding agents: one start call per task, test and check runs through a budgeted runner with a stop-after-green rule and shaped output, a guard that flags rewritten pre-existing tests, and pointer-based project memory. Token savings are not demonstrated yet.
defaultPrompt: Use context-harness for this change: start once, run checks through the harness, keep existing tests intact, then report.
